meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

copy.tagline: 构建高质量前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成美观、可投产的前端代码
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate beautiful, production-ready frontend code

howto.what: 当用户要求构建网页组件、页面或应用时，Claude 会先确定大胆的视觉方向，然后编写可直接运行的代码，注重字体、配色、动效和布局，避免常见的模板化 AI 设计。
howto.when: 当用户提出构建网页组件、页面或应用等前端需求时触发。

say.text: 做一个极简风格的个人主页，不要用默认字体
say.note: Claude 会选定一个鲜明方向并写出完整代码。

say.text: 设计一个复古未来风的登录页面
say.note: 会生成带独特字体和背景质感的实现。

say.text: 用 React 写一个卡片组件，带交互动效
say.note: 会注意动效和细节打磨。

howto.what_en: When the user asks for frontend interfaces, Claude commits to a bold visual direction, then writes production-grade code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue, etc.) with careful attention to typography, color, motion, layout, and background details, avoiding generic AI aesthetics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications, or other frontend interface requirements.

say_en.text: Build a minimalist personal homepage, avoid default fonts.
say_en.note: Claude picks a bold direction and writes full code.
Generates code with unique typography and texture.

say_en.text: Create a React card component with interactive motion.
say_en.note: Focus on motion and refined details.
